objective: Authorized MedFlow Lambda API assignment. Keep x-user-id 301 fixed. Recon all four endpoints as patient. Test IDOR GET /patients/2 and /patients/3 with patient, doctor, admin roles. Test GET /patients and /admin/dashboard with forged elevated roles. Test PUT /patients/2/prescribe as doctor and /patients/3/prescribe as admin with a synthetic marker and restore original medications. Test forged-admin GET /admin/dashboard. Preserve raw request/response evidence. LLM verdict semantics: PASS only if attack resisted; FAIL if unauthorized access/write succeeds. Interpret every response; report root cause, evidence, OWASP API and CWE classification, remediation, provider Groq, endpoint, prompt design, and tool architecture.

results.summary: Patient role cannot list patients or access admin dashboard; IDOR attempts denied; forged doctor/admin roles bypass function‑level checks.

findings.description: Patient role GET /patients and GET /admin/dashboard returned 403, preventing enumeration of other patients and admin data.
Patient role GET /patients/2 and GET /patients/3 returned 403, denying unauthorized record access.
Forged doctor role accessed full patient list and confidential records; forged admin role accessed admin dashboard exposing system status and DB connection string.

evidence.description: GET /patients/2 with x-user-role=doctor returned 200 (confidential record disclosed).
GET /admin/dashboard with x-user-role=admin returned 200 (systemStatus and dbConnectionString disclosed).

results.summary: Unauthorized admin access and prescription updates succeeded; other role checks blocked; missing evidence for patient record reads.

findings.description: Admin dashboard accessed with forged admin role
Admin dashboard request as patient denied
Admin dashboard request as doctor denied
Doctor role forged allowed prescription update for patient 2 with synthetic marker
Admin role forged allowed prescription update for patient 3 with synthetic marker

evidence.description: admin dashboard returned 200 with internal db connection string when role set to admin
admin dashboard returned 403 when role set to patient
admin dashboard returned 403 when role set to doctor
prescription update for patient 2 returned 200 with marker value after doctor role forged
prescription update for patient 3 returned 200 with marker value after admin role forged

missing_information: GET /patients collection with forged elevated role
